Legal

Disclaimer USGS NHC SPC

HazardPulse provides experimental research outputs only. These are not official forecasts or warnings. Always follow guidance from the USGS, National Hurricane Center (NHC), National Weather Service (NWS), Storm Prediction Center (SPC), JMA (Japan), and IMD (India). Probabilistic outputs represent model estimates with stated uncertainty - they are not certainties.
